description: The company's risk factors, condensed from Item 1A of its annual report and updated from its latest quarterly report, grouped by theme (demand, supply chain, competition, regulation, legal, financial, macro, cybersecurity), with risks that are new, expanded or removed since the prior filing flagged. Read from the filings, not from news. Returns the section's full text as markdown. Headings differ by company and carry the fiscal period, so the section is found by pattern; if this company's narrative has none, the response says so and lists its sections. Pass `record` for the narrative as of an earlier record.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_risk_factors
title: Risk factors
